verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for browser-automation and scraping infrastructure, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only Browserbase's hosted cloud: sessions run 'on Browserbase', and agents are deployed 'on Browserbase'. Community discussion points to BrowserStation, a separate project, as the open-source alternative, which is a user-side workaround rather than Browserbase's own capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
